i209 | - | kind:question layer:macro cause:doc-gap outcome:docs-answer pr_potential:docs-fix conf:stated depth=full | Can arbitrary Unicode characters (emoji, coins) be mapped? Maintainer explained: key-mapper sends keycodes, environment decides the symbol; no keycode exists for emoji. Workaround: Ctrl+Shift+U+codepoint (GTK-specific, risky). Docs gap: explicit statement that emoji/arbitrary Unicode is not generally supported.

i210 | - | kind:question layer:mapping cause:doc-gap cause:x11-issue outcome:docs-answer pr_potential:docs-fix conf:stated depth=full | Cyrillic symbols and tilde (~) not mappable directly on Linux Mint/Cinnamon with Russian+English layout. Root: xmodmap-based key names depend on active layout; tilde not in xmodmap output. Maintainer explained the xmodmap-based lookup and KEY_ vs xmodmap distinction. Multi-layout complexities not fully resolved.

i211 | - | kind:bug layer:install cause:distro-compat component:gui-app outcome:fixed pr_potential:unknown conf:stated impact:install-blocked depth=full | GTK CSS deprecation warning blocked startup because psutil was still required. Maintainer removed psutil dependency.

i212 | - | kind:bug layer:daemon cause:autoload-failure cause:de-compat component:service de_os:arch de_os:wayland outcome:workaround pr_potential:docs-fix conf:stated impact:broken-remap symptom:service-unit-issue depth=full | Sway on Arch: autoloading on startup not working. Root: Sway affects environment variables that some systemd units depend on for X/Wayland detection; key-mapper-service starts before Sway but the .desktop autoload runs after Sway login. Workaround: run key-mapper-control --command autoload from ~/.profile or Sway autostart. Docs gap: document non-systemd-autostart environments.
